query.description: What you are looking for, in plain language

answer.description: Also synthesise an answer from the results

full.description: Re-embed everything, not just changed files

daemonUrl.description: Where `modelctl serve` is listening. Only 127.0.0.1:8077 and localhost:8077 are reachable — a different port needs a matching net:fetch permission in plugin.json.

token.description: Sent as X-Modelctl-Token. Leave empty unless the daemon was started with --token.

embedModel.description: Embedding model for newly indexed folders. Changing it invalidates the whole index.

chunkSize.description: Tokens per chunk, capped at the model's window (LaBSE: 254). Changing it invalidates the index.

autoRefresh.description: When the panel opens, re-index folders whose files changed. Off: only show how stale they are.

answerUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint answer mode asks first (LM Studio). Only localhost:1234 and 127.0.0.1:1234 are reachable without a plugin.json change.

answerModel.description: Model to ask at answerUrl. Empty: whichever model LM Studio has loaded.

fallbackModel.description: Catalog model modelctld answers with when LM Studio is not running or has nothing loaded. Must be downloaded; larger answers better.
